name: Contourlet Transform Analysis
description: Applies contourlet decomposition to capture smooth contour features missed by wavelets — based on Do & Vetterli (2005).
mechanism: The image is violently stripped down via a Laplacian Pyramid interwoven with a Directional Filter Bank. The algorithm forces the image to surrender its ultra-fine frequencies across multi-directional axes. When an AI generates a diagonal eyelash or a sweeping wave, it bleeds energetic 'shear marks' wildly contradicting authentic light diffusion physics. The Contourlet meter screeches in alarm the moment it traps these synthetic 'plastic edges'.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用
